args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08).
Checks: every final check passed, apart from plane sections on r06 and r08, which wasn't run. Both runs kept only the usual width-free remedy and had no roll-backs.
Profiles: the centre strain-rate (REGR) peak is about 53.1–53.3 %/h, always 421 µm from the tip. The growth zone is 674–695 µm long.
Large z-scores: these come from a batch MAD near zero, so they mark small differences. r02 and r06 have a growth zone 21 µm (about 3%) shorter and a largest flank difference of -0.81 %/h, about 1.5% of the peak. r05, r07 and r08 have their largest flank difference, which is small, at 347 µm.
Flagged runs: none, so they have nothing in common.
